description.shortText: A small robotic self-driven vehicle that uses machine vision and path planning optimization to autonomously clean urban areas.

attachments.name: Trombia Free is an electric, autonomous and silent street sweeper
attachments.description: Developed in finland, Trombia Free consumes only 15% of the energy required by conventional brushing vacuum cleaning machines

attachments.name: Sidewalk Labs
attachments.description: Sidewalk Labs is an Alphabet company that imagines, designs, tests, and builds urban innovations to help cities meet their biggest challenges.

attachments.name: Robots designed to clean up our streets
attachments.description: DUSTBOT ('Networked and Cooperating Robots for Urban Hygiene') is an original idea, which operates robots in partially unstructured environments (such as squares, streets, parks) to sweep up rubbish and dirt. They can also collect small quantities of home rubbish on demand from citizens, at their doors.

attachments.name: Autonomous robotic street sweeping: Initial attempt for curbside sweeping
attachments.description: Autonomous street sweeping is an interesting robotic application because such street cleaning requires tedious and exhaustive human efforts of manual sweeping with brooms, blowing tools, or driving sweeping vehicles within a large area or along a long extension of roads on a regular basis. Toward autonomous street cleaning, we present our recent development of an autonomous robotic street sweeper. The developed system is aimed at autonomous cleaning with low cost hardware. In this work, a commercialized manual brush sweeper is robotized and equipped with two fish-eye cameras for environmental sensing. As an initial attempt of autonomous street sweeping, we show the cleaning performance of the robot along the curbside based on curbside recognition and tracking with top-view images.

attachments.name: Autonomous Sweepers Keep Roads Clean in Major Chinese Cities
attachments.description: Over 100 of these self-driving vehicles, which automatically clean and water road surfaces, are already in operation.

attachments.name: Blade Runner 2049
attachments.description: Directed by Denis Villeneuve.  With Harrison Ford, Ryan Gosling, Ana de Armas, Dave Bautista. A young blade runner's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former blade runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

attachments.name: ENWAY
attachments.description: Enway technology enables autonomous street sweeping. We achieve centimeter precise navigation and path planning optimised for street cleaning. We believe in supervised autonomy, where an autonomous vehicle works together with human workers to make our streets cleaner.

attachments.name: Boschung Unveils Fully Autonomous Street Sweeper
attachments.description: Boschung today announces the launch of the Urban-Sweeper S2.0 driven by WIBOT. A pioneer in the industry, the 100% electricUrban-Sweeper S2.0 has now become a fully autonomous street sweeper featuring the most advanced revolutionary technologies.
